notes: S2-FIX3 F72 (decision 2026-11-16 #1; §5.3, Q2): human-1 (a keyset root) has a valid 'retired' revocation effective at T1. A human declaration of key A recorded at T2 is cosigned by human-1: that cosignature fails §9.4, so A's declaration is invalid E_KEY_REVOKED and supplies no key material at all. A human declaration of key B recorded at T3 is cosigned by A: A's signature has no material (unverified), so B's declaration is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN, not trusted through A; a note signed by B at T5 is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN. A key that gained trust only through a declaration that supplies no material never hands trust on.
